title: Reheating with Axion-SU(2) and Gravitational Chern-Simons Couplings
summary: We study the early stages of an oscillatory reheating phase in an inflaton plus spectator axion-SU(2) system, including both an axion-gauge Chern-Simons coupling $χF\tilde{F}$ and a gravitational Chern-Simons coupling $χR\tilde{R}$. Assuming an isotropic SU(2) background configuration of chromo-natural type and quadratic potentials, we numerically solve the coupled background and tensor perturbation equations during the first e-fold of reheating.
